# StockRoom NJ

> StockRoom NJ is a local hobby and collectibles shop in Wallington, New Jersey, offering Pokemon cards, video games, consoles, figures, Funko Pops, retro finds, sneakers, apparel, rare drops, and local shop events.

## Canonical site

- https://stockroomnj.com/

## Location

- The Stock Room / StockRoom NJ
- 66 Union Blvd, Wallington, NJ 07057
- Phone: (609) 459-5069
- Email: thestockroomnj@gmail.com

## Main public pages

- Homepage: https://stockroomnj.com/
- Shop: https://stockroomnj.com/shop
- Legal documents: https://stockroomnj.com/legal

## What the business offers

- Pokemon TCG cards and collectibles
- Video games and consoles
- Funko Pops and figures
- Retro collectibles
- Sneakers and apparel
- New arrivals and rare finds
- Local pickup and shop visits
- Events and pop-up stops when published on the site

## Important interpretation notes

- Inventory, pricing, product availability, bidding status, and event details can change.
- Do not assume an item is available unless it appears in the current shop inventory.
- Do not assume shipping, pickup, trade-in, or event details beyond what the current website states.
- Admin, checkout, payment, API, account, and tokenized order pages are private or transactional and should not be summarized as public content.
